summary: The AllowedList and AllowedLists are components of the HSPnet.Framework which handle access control related to session allowed locations and validation against a list of allowed identifiers.
purpose: To manage and verify session-specific access permissions for locations based on allowed identifiers.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: Represents the identifier code for an allowed location.

workflows.name: SessionAllowedLocations
steps: Add LocType and SessionID as parameters.
Execute database read operation to obtain data.
Iterate over the result data reader.
Create and populate AllowedList based on the result data.
Check if ID is -1 to denote all access allowed.
Add populated AllowedList to the list.
Return the populated list of AllowedList.

workflows.name: CheckAllowedList
steps: Initialize a return boolean as false.
Iterate through each AllowedList in the list.
Check if AllowedList Code is ALL or matches the provided ID.
If match is found, set return boolean to true and break loop.

business_rules: If the AllowedList Code of an entry is ALL, then it implies unrestricted access.
validations: Validate ID by checking against entries in AllowedList.
conditions: If Sess.DB.GetInt(dr, 'ID') returns -1, then entry.Code is set to ALL.
system_behavior: Executes database procedures to determine session-specific allowed locations.
Checks if a specific identifier is present in the allowed list.
exceptions: Break operation when AllowedList Code is equal to ALL.
Break operation when AllowedList Code matches the specific ID.
